_source: PERSON. A teammate plays this person and answers only in character, with what that person would really know.
_note: These are call OUTCOMES, not API responses. The teammate picks the outcome, then speaks or types the reply. Reply audio goes through the speech port, or the reply is typed. Never a hint about what the agent should do next.

clinic_no_slot.said: No slots left today. Earliest is tomorrow 11 am. You can walk in after 6 pm and wait.

clinic_slot_offered.said: We have 4:30 pm today with the duty doctor. Name and age?

chemist_out_of_stock.said: That one is out of stock. I have a different brand of the same thing if you want.

chemist_in_stock.said: Yes, I have a full strip. Three hundred and twenty rupees.

chemist_in_stock_inhaler.said: Yes, I have the Budesonide Formoterol inhaler. Four hundred and eighty rupees for one.

chemist_in_stock_kazipet.said: Yes, Metoprolol 25 mg is available. Three hundred and twenty rupees for sixty tablets.

chemist_substitute_only.said: We don't have Metoprolol 25 mg right now. I can give you Atenolol 25 mg instead, same class. Two hundred rupees.

ambulance_dispatched.said: Ambulance dispatched. Give me the address and a landmark. It will take about twelve minutes.

clinic_no_answer_ringing._note: Nobody at the desk. The agent must redial before moving on (R11).

clinic_doctor_away.said: Doctor is not in today, he has gone to a camp. He will be back on Thursday. Shall I keep a slot for Thursday morning?

clinic_fully_booked.said: Sorry, today is completely full. Doctor has thirty patients already. Nothing free before Thursday eleven o'clock.

clinic_second_has_slot.said: Yes, we have tomorrow nine thirty in the morning. Give me the patient name and age and I will write it down.
